user.title: Device Floorplan
user.description: Device Floorplan adds a **Floorplan Editor** to your sidebar. There you create your first plan from a drawing, a photo or a sample, and place your devices on it.

existing.title: Device Floorplan

Keep them: they appear in the **Floorplan Editor** in your sidebar, with all positions. Or start over:

init.title: New devices
init.description: What happens when you add a device to Home Assistant after setting up your plans.

data.notify_new_devices: Show a notification when new devices are added
data.auto_place_new_devices: Put new devices on the plan next to their room (approximate)

get_positions.name: Get positions
get_positions.description: Returns the devices, room pins and scale of one plan.

plan.name: Plan
plan.description: Plan id or name, e.g. ground_floor.

show_overlay.name: Show overlay
show_overlay.description: Switches every Device Floorplan card with this card ID to an overlay and/or a floor, on every screen.

card_id.name: Card ID
card_id.description: The card ID set in the card editor.

overlay.name: Overlay
overlay.description: plan, live, lights, comfort, security, network, health, a custom overlay's ID, or reset (back to the card's default).

floor.name: Floor
floor.description: Optional: the plan id (or HA floor id) of the floor to show, for cards with several floors.

get_layout.name: Get layout
get_layout.description: The floorplan as facts: floors, rooms, which rooms connect (open space, passage, door) or only share a wall, outside walls, compass position when the plan has a north. With a room: also what is in it.

floor.name: Floor
floor.description: Optional: a plan or HA floor name.

room.name: Room
room.description: Optional: a room (area) name; also lists its devices.

locate.name: Locate
locate.description: Where a device, entity or room is: floor, room and its spot in the room.

target.name: Target
target.description: A device name, entity id, device id or room.

nearest.name: Nearest
nearest.description: Devices nearest to a device or room on the same floor, with metres when the floor is measured.

target.name: Target
target.description: A device name, entity id or room.

between.name: Between
between.description: Between two devices or rooms: the way through the rooms, the distance and the walls or openings a straight line crosses.

from.name: From
from.description: A device name, entity id or room.

to.name: To
to.description: A device name, entity id or room.
